notes: New menu: Home, Report, Train, Play, Learn, Tools and Brain Games, with chess.com-style fly-out menus.
New trainers: Blunder Shield (is this move safe?), Conversion Trainer (win your winning positions against Stockfish) and Sparring (play your own openings against your coach).
New tools: Board Editor and Board Setup, Elo Calculator, Chess Pieces and a Chess Clock for over-the-board games.
Brain Games: Square Colour, Knight Sprint, Attack Count and Board Memory, 60 seconds each.
Your Report now drives Today's plan: the area that holds your rating back most gets its trainer every day, and Progress shows how your areas improve.
Settings is redesigned, with your restore code and account switching in one place.
